name: Gemma 4
summary: Download Gemma 4 through Ollama and run it locally as a ForkMesh coding agent.

license.terms: The integration is MIT licensed; downloaded Gemma model weights retain their upstream licence.

permissions.label: Download the selected Gemma 4 model from Ollama's model registry
Ask the locally installed Ollama runtime to inspect, download, and remove this model
Store several gigabytes of model weights in Ollama's device-local model directory
Run the selected model as a coding agent in an isolated ForkMesh worktree

screenshots.alt: Gemma 4's violet and teal crystalline coding-agent portrait
